body.summary: Replaced the hardcoded 'claude' assistant who-label in the chat webview with a render-time compose of the echoed run-config identity (setRunIdentity + assistantLabel: PROVIDER/MODEL, '' model = bare provider, '' provider = 'assistant'). Seeded at bootstrap from the run-config button data-* attrs and re-seeded on every run-config message; postRestored now posts run-config BEFORE session-restored so replayed rows compose the restored session's identity. 'run-config' is registered in HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES.
